name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated response is connected to the context and the previous conversation. A relevant response should be logically related to the conversation topic and maintain the flow of the discussion.

name: Coherence
description: Measures the logical consistency and grammatical correctness of the generated response. A coherent response should be easy to understand, grammatically sound, and logically structured.

name: Interestingness
description: Measures how engaging and captivating the generated response is. An interesting response should provide new and valuable information, share unique perspectives, or spark curiosity.

name: Informativeness
description: Measures the amount of new and relevant information provided in the generated response. An informative response should contain factual details, insights, or opinions that contribute to the conversation.

name: Fluency
description: Measures the grammatical correctness and readability of the generated response. A fluent response should be easy to read, contain proper sentence structures, and use appropriate punctuation and capitalization.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how well the generated response encourages further conversation or interaction. An engaging response should inspire the other party to continue discussing the topic or ask follow-up questions.
